label: Ecosystem flux
text: BI.O.A5.4 Ecosystem flux. Energy flow and matter cycling through a community plus the abiotic pool. Trophic transfer efficiency measured across ecosystems runs about 5–20 percent (Pauly and Christensen 1995). The 10 percent rule is a heuristic (BI.M.H). Biological carbon and nitrogen fluxes are owned here. CONTESTED: AGU files them in Biogeosciences; alternative home EA.O.A4.3. Water balance is EA.O.A4.2.

warrant.standard: Replicated field or mesocosm experiment; time series with stated uncertainty
warrant.defeaters: Pseudoreplication; scale mismatch; confounded gradients; detection bias
